limitations: Small fixed-policy sensitivity check, not a new global optimization or complete source-strategy search. Late alloy purchases were mostly skipped before the final sold-ingot goal; unchanged completion time does not establish their usefulness for speedruns. Fully developed home industry remains dominant. Higher grade prices can improve a heuristic route by changing buying priorities, not by making the underlying economy richer.
